UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences and configuration synchronized with Firebase Firestore.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

useAutoLocation.description: Whether to determine location automatically using GPS.

volume.description: Adhan audio playback volume ratio between 0.0 and 1.0.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PrayerLog.title: PrayerLog
PrayerLog.description: Record of a completed prayer or daily spiritual tracking item.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

prayerType.description: Identifier of the prayer (e.g. fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User synchronized prayer preferences and settings.

/users/{userId}/prayer_logs/{logId}.description: Daily prayer performance tracker logs per user.
